definitions.explanation: A child of one's aunt or uncle. The kanji writing varies depending on the gender and relative age of the cousin.

examples.japanese: {従兄弟|いとこ}は{三人|さんにん}いる。
{夏休|なつやす}みに{従兄弟|いとこ}の{家|いえ}に{泊|と}まりに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to stay at my cousin's house during summer vacation.

notes:
KANJI VARIATIONS:
The kanji used depends on the cousin's gender and whether they are older or younger:
- {従兄弟|いとこ}: male cousin (general)
- {従姉妹|いとこ}: female cousin
- {従兄|いとこ}: older male cousin
- {従弟|いとこ}: younger male cousin
- {従姉|いとこ}: older female cousin
- {従妹|いとこ}: younger female cousin

All are read いとこ. In practice, hiragana いとこ or the general {従兄弟|いとこ} is most common.

RELATED TERMS:
- {又従兄弟|またいとこ}: second cousin
- はとこ: second cousin (colloquial)
